mostWorthwhile.text: Processing and exporting the collagen was most worthwhile because it connected work inside a cell to support outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the collagen fibers to the body felt predictable after making them, although the result clearly showed the remaining surface gap.

surprise.text: I was interested that collagen is assembled into supporting fibers outside the cell after being processed and exported.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the offered combinations followed the repair goals, although the final choices were the only available combinations.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter if it connected the cellular work to another visible body-level outcome; that connection was the most interesting part here, though several choices felt predictable.
